text:
Stop saying impossible. It's the most expensive lie you tell yourself.

You've said it this week. About money, about a goal, about yourself.

Ford gave engineers one job: build an 8 cylinder engine block in one piece. They said it can't be done. For a year they said it.

Then they figured it out.

The word 'impossible' is not a wall. It is a decision to stop looking for the door.

Stop deciding to quit. That is the whole strategy.
caption:
Most men with a success mindset share one habit: they refuse the word impossible. Discipline over comfort, always.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#discipline #mindset #selfimprovement #success #mentalstrength
